控制内容_trzyn9: Controls public URLs for content. After a rule change, old URLs 301 to the new ones instead of 404ing.
规则优先_1smnwi: Rule priority (top to bottom, overrides earlier ones)
单条内容_3q2f4c: Per-entry custom URL — set “Custom URL” on the entry edit page; highest priority, unaffected by later rule changes
栏目_zzrbot: Category / tag overrides — set individually in Categories or Tags; apply only to that one category or tag
站点默认_1j15gq: Site default rules — the ones below on this page, applied site-wide
注意_ngvcv9: Note: category-level rules only set the category page's own URL, not article URLs under it — article URLs depend on whether the site default rules use
只读权限_c4jjhf: Read-only permission; rules cannot be modified
栏目级规_1xr4xo: Category-level rules come in two kinds: the category page URL and the article URL under it — they don't interfere. To change them, edit the category in Categories.
暂无栏目_9uva6b: No custom category rules or templates
标签页对_1o29mp: Tag pages are the most SEO-friendly; short slugs are recommended. To change them, edit the tag in Tags.
每次保存_187kpk: Previous rules are archived here on each save, used to 301 old URLs to new ones. Up to 50 are kept.
